title: Lekalo PHP Operations Map
description: Closed contract for the deterministic operations map sidecar the PHP Laravel operations emitter writes beside its artifacts (issue #59). The sidecar is the custody receipt: it binds every emitted or declared entrypoint to its semantic id, input/result/error roles, ports, policy and transaction bindings, and carries the complete path-sorted artifact inventory with content digests. The sidecar never contains declaration byte ranges - source-map documents are a separate `declarations` shape, and this sidecar's `.map.json` suffix therefore binds nothing in the core source-map ingester. The map's own file digest belongs to the ownership manifest, never inside the hashed content.

digests.description: The exact input digests this map was derived from; any change invalidates the derivation.

typesInput.description: The bound types input document digest.

operations.description: One entry per declared operation, sorted by id.

artifacts.description: The complete artifact inventory, path-sorted, every file the plan covers (emitted bytes under the custody root; declared-only maintained entries for checked/custom carry a `declared: true` role and no digest).

recipe.description: The managed recipe kind actually emitted, or the bounded unsupported reason when the operation was declared managed but refused.

input.description: The input role: the reused types-family command input FQN, or the operations-family query input FQN the map emits.

result.description: The result role: the mapped return type identity (types-family FQN), or null for a unit command.

errors.description: The declared domain error classes (infrastructure-category registry members never appear here), sorted by id.

ports.description: The injected dependency ports of the handler, sorted by name.

role.description: repository: the narrow read/write interface of one entity. policy: the per-operation authorization port. events: the per-operation event dispatch port. transactions: the shared transaction port. delegation: the port the port-delegation recipe delegates to.

entity.description: For repository ports: the entity semantic id.

policy.description: The declared policy binding id, when the operation declares one.

effects.description: The declared IR effect ids the operation resolves to, sorted; the reconciliation baseline for the detected-effect join.

role.description: handler: the entrypoint class. ports: narrow per-operation interfaces. shared: ActorContext, TransactionPort, OperationError. repository: a per-entity repository interface. errors: typed domain error classes. classmap: the deterministic class map. sidecar: this map.

operation.description: The owning operation id for handler/ports/errors artifacts.

digest.description: The content digest; required for every emitted role and forbidden for declared-only rows.
